correctness.rationale: For each finite field F_q and 3-element E, the unordered nonconstant evaluation image of ax+b is aE+b, and two nonconstant messages give the same output iff their maps differ by affine set stabilizer H_E. The H_E action is free on affine parameter pairs so every nonconstant fiber has cardinality |H_E|, with q(q-1)/|H_E| such outputs; constant fibers are singleton. Faithful action H_E↪S3 leaves orders 1,2,3,6. Characteristic2 has no affine involution preserving odd triples, but primitive cube-root multiplication gives q(q-1)/3 order-3 triples if 3|q-1. Characteristic3 arithmetic progression triples are translation cosets with full six-element stabilizer, q(q-1)/6 of them; otherwise H_E trivial. Other odd characteristics yield q(q-1)/2 midpoint/arithmetic triples of order2, and q(q-1)/3 disjoint cube-root orbit triples of order3 only if 3|q-1; the rest order1. Verified independent exact affine-group/stabilizer enumeration for q=3 (one order6), q=5 (10 order2), q=7 (21 order2 plus 14 order3), q=8 (56 order1), plus direct unordered message fibers for those fields. First admissible q=8: every triple is rigid, thus all q^2=64 messages have distinct unordered outputs; q<8 prime powers 2,3,4,5,7 fail by classifications. The all-prime-power result rests on stabilizer orbit theory, not finite samples.
residual_risks: Assumes exactly three distinct evaluation points and affine polynomials degree<2; permutation-only, zero-edit channel.
Does NOT imply correction of positive numbers of insertions, deletions or substitutions, nor a general n,k Reed–Solomon decoder.
